residual_risks: This REM does not re-open the sealed C4 adapter's broader contract: for canonical URN/digest inputs (the only values the sealed callers pass) the generated TypeQL queries are byte-identical to the pre-fix output, so the real-backend acceptance suites of OCOR-DEV-0037/0038/0039 are unaffected and remain sealed.

The full local suite (905 passed) is recorded here for the first time in this REM's own evidence; the prior RCCAD candidate (OCOR-DEV-REM-0014-RCCAD-20261001) had delegated the complete run to CI. This record supersedes that candidate with the complete local run.
rollback_procedure_verified: Reverting the two REM-0014 commits (RED bb893ef, GREEN 5b6b027) re-exposes the injection (watermark split + injected fact) and the RED tests fail again; no data or schema migration is involved. The pre-fix baseline (cf86666cba1ab267347dc9a188461412c918db8b) was directly demonstrated to fail the 15 negative cases as EXPECTED_FAILURE.
